result.transcript: Which remitters sent to more than three banks this quarter?

cypher_attempts.query:
MATCH (r:Remitter)-[:SENT]->(t:Transfer)-[:TO]->(a:Account)-[:AT]->(b:Bank)
WHERE t.ts >= datetime('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z')
WITH r, count(DISTINCT b.code) AS banks
WHERE banks > 3
RETURN r.rmid AS rmid, r.name AS name, banks
ORDER BY banks DESC
LIMIT 200

result.answer: Naveed Abbasi sent to 4 banks this quarter.
